card.name: Verb right after a subject in a clause
card.fires_on: Auxiliary or linking words such as to, have, would, may, might, be, is and 'd that come right after a subject (noun or pronoun) and before the main verb. Seen in general narrative web text.

modes.label: Modal after subject
modes.description: A modal like would, may, might or 'd follows a subject pronoun or noun and expects a verb next.
